I replied to Dana in our DM: "Got it, Dana. I've noted that Dock 38 is your dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from now on, and I'll keep that between us."

The note is saved in gbrain as a private fact about Dana (fact #2). My first save (fact #1) went in visible to everyone by default. Because she told me this in a DM, I expired that one and saved it again as private.
